data.narrative:
Tandem PV is a Series A climate-tech company founded by Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher, operating in the broader Climate & Energy sector alongside 8 identified private peers and 1 public comparable (Lianza, ticker LNZA). The company has raised approximately $87M to date.

Valuation was approached using stage-progression analysis, the only method with sufficient applicability given data constraints. This method applies a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x to the $87M total raised as a proxy baseline, implying a valuation of $174M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied: while 8 same-sector peers exist (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix), none yielded three or more datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier, creating insufficient granularity for robust comparison.

The triangulation supports a median valuation of $174M, with a plausible range of $148M to $200M reflecting reasonable variance around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage peer pricing power to validate multiples and limited visibility into Tandem PV's specific unit economics relative to the identified peer set. Any refinement would benefit from additional private-market transaction data within the narrow climate-tech frontier-technology segment.
